acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

addPricePool(uint8,bytes).details: Reverts if that normalized pair already has an official pool.

params.data: The data that was passed to the call to lock

returns._0: Any data that you want to be returned from the lock call

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

pricePoolId(address,address).details: Token order does not matter and native coin is normalized to `wrappedNative`.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

swapExactInput(address,address,uint256,u.details: The caller cannot provide or pin a path. The latest owner-managed route is resolved      when the transaction executes. A route may mix supported V2, V3 and V4 pools, and      `tokenIn` or `tokenOut` may be address(0) for native coin.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner.

params.data: The data that was passed to the call to unlock

returns._0: Any data that you want to be returned from the unlock call

addPricePool(uint8,bytes).notice: Registers the first official pool for a token pair.

lockAcquired(bytes).notice: Called by the pool manager on `msg.sender` when a lock is acquired

pricePoolId(address,address).notice: Returns the stable registry ID for a normalized token pair.

replacePricePool(uint8,bytes).notice: Replaces a token pair's current official pool without changing its stable ID or any route.

setV3Router(address,address,bool).notice: Compatible exactInputSingle routers (SwapRouter02-style, no deadline in tuple).

swapExactInput(address,address,uint256,u.notice: Swaps an exact input amount over the platform's current route.

unlockCallback(bytes).notice: Called by the pool manager on `msg.sender` when the manager is unlocked
